answerconstraint-badcode-qr.reason: terminology without a server (licensed SNOMED CT): the stored Java outcome was produced with a terminology server that knows SNOMED and rejects '111111111000' as an unknown code; the pod never bundles SNOMED content and its provider answers Unknown — a warning, never a guess.

nested-questionnaire-nested-valueset.reason: definition resolution: the ValueSet beside the questionnaire includes http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/CodeSystem/CSPHQ9, a URL in HL7's space that names no definition the pod holds (the SDC package is not carried), so the pod reports it; validator_cli 6.10.4 knows it as a published SDC definition and does not, though it refuses http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/CodeSystem/nope the same way the pod does (probed 2026-10-20, -tx n/a, no SDC package). Both sides report the questionnaireAdaptive extension as not found. The nine coded answers (a code, no system, in the contained set) are warnings on both sides since 0.22.1 (conformance/coded-answers/).

attachment-inconsistent-size-qr.reason: attachment integrity (docs/scope.md): the stated `size` against the decoded `data` length is not checked; the questionnaire's own maxSize rule is (attachment-max-size-qr agrees).

choice-async-qr.reason: terminology without a server and display names: the stored outcome rejects the coding because its display ('Australia' for ISO 3166 BD) is wrong for the terminology server's copy of the code system; the pod holds neither the jurisdiction set (a filter over ISO 3166 / UN M49) nor display strings.

choice-gender-coding-async-qr.reason: display names: the code 'string' is a member of item-type; the stored outcome rejects it for its wrong display ('Australia' for String). The pod does not check displays (docs/scope.md).

open-choice-gender-coding-async-qr.reason: display names: as choice-gender-coding-async-qr, on an open-choice item.

quantity-units-not-in-value-set-qr.reason: terminology without a server: the unit value set (http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/jurisdiction, a filter over external systems) is not bundled; the provider answers Unknown and the pod warns that the set could not be found rather than judging the unit.

string-with-coding-async-qr.reason: terminology without a server: the string answer is held to the jurisdiction value set, which is not bundled; Unknown → a warning, not an error.
